support.title: Support access
support.lede: Squares whose owner has let rootsquares staff in for a while. A session opens only while the owner's grant is on; every use is logged and mailed to the owner.
support.activeEmpty: No square has support access switched on.
support.requestsEmpty: No requests. Staff can ask an owner for access from a square's page.
support.cardOff: The owner has not granted support access. You can ask with a note; the owner is mailed and decides.
support.requestSent: Request sent. The owner has been mailed.
support.popup: The window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.

errors.no_active_grant: The owner has not granted support access, or it has ended.
errors.rate_limited: Too many support sessions started in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.grant_active: Access is already granted for this square.
errors.request_waiting: You already asked for this square and the owner has not answered.

opex.title: Costs
opex.sub: What running the platform costs, in US dollars. Add a cost line once; the year view spreads it over the months.
opex.emptyText: Add what you pay for: hosting, e-mail, tools, domains. Each line says how often it is paid.
opex.removeText: The line disappears from every month. This cannot be undone.
opex.badForm: Fill in the name, category, a positive amount and the start date.
opex.fEndHint: Leave empty while it is still running.
opex.fRiseHint: A raise that applies once a year from the start, 0 for none.
opex.noMonthly: Nothing to show for this year yet.
opex.assumeNote: Changes apply to the table above once saved.
opex.ratesNote: 1 USD = {rate} {code} on {date} ({source}). An indication only; amounts you type stay in US dollars.
opex.noRates: No rate for {code} yet. Press Refresh rates, or type one.
opex.fShareHint: For example 2.9 for a payment fee of 2.9 %.
opex.variableNote: Worked out each month from the payments received. Months ahead use the forecast.
opex.recordText: This replaces the planned amount of that cost in that month. Delete it to go back to the plan.
opex.badReal: Choose a cost, a month and an amount of 0 or more.
opex.fcSub: Costs ahead from your cost lines, against revenue that already renews plus the new squares you expect. Pick a scenario and change the numbers below.
opex.actualHead: Revenue received in the last months
opex.assumptionsSub: Kept on the platform. Revenue per square empty means the average of what squares pay now.
opex.badAssumptions: Use numbers: new squares 0 or more, lost squares 0 to 100 %, money 0 or more.

prospects.convertBody: Choose the square this person created. The Package tab of that square opens; when you save it, this prospect is marked Agreed.
prospects.title: Prospects
prospects.sub: People who asked to speak to us about a custom package.
prospects.note: on the Pricing page. Use them only to answer; delete a row when the person asks or the contact is over.
prospects.notesHint: What was said, what was agreed, when to call back
prospects.deleteBody: The person's details are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
prospects.emptyText: When someone fills in "Nothing fits you?" on the Pricing page, they appear here.

custom.title: Custom package
custom.lede: Agree the modules and one amount per period with this square, then make it a custom package. Nothing is for sale: the Pricing page only says "speak to us".
custom.ledeOn: This square is a custom package. Changing the modules or the amount here applies from the next payment; modules that are no longer in the list stay switched on until the owner saves the Modules page, and nothing is deleted.
custom.eventFixed: This is an Event pass. It is fixed and cannot be made a custom package.
custom.fromProspect: Opened from a prospect. When you save, that prospect is marked Agreed.
custom.amountHint: USD, tax included as in the prices
custom.guideLine: Guide for this selection: at least {amount} per month (step {n})
custom.guideOk: Set by the platform admin on the Prices page. It is advice, not a rule.
custom.guideLow: The amount is below the guide. You can still save it.
custom.note: The owner pays this one amount through the normal payment page. The square stays Live: no Keep, no package upgrade.

pb.hint: Click a part to see its chain · tick the box to switch it on or off.
pb.offDone: Everything is off. Tick a part to start; what it needs comes with it.
pb.modulesOffDone: All modules are off; the always-on parts stay.

map.title: Map
map.text: Build left to right: each part needs everything to its left that it connects to.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
hierarchy.text: Read top to bottom: each part sits below everything it needs. Click a part to light its chain.

steps.title: Switch-on steps
steps.text: Everything in a step can be switched on together once the steps above it are on. Click a part to light up what it waits for and what waits for it.

outline.title: Outline
outline.text: Each part sits under the last thing it waits for. Extra requirements show as tags.

pb.needsNothing: Nothing: it stands on its own.
pb.pick: Click a part to see what it needs and what needs it.

guide.title: Custom package guide
guide.lede: A guiding minimum per month for each step of a custom package, shown to whoever agrees a package on a square's Package tab. Advice, not a rule. A package that reaches a step gets the highest guide up to that step. Leave a step empty for no guide.

invoice.title: Invoice details
invoice.lede: Who issues the invoices that owners print from their Payments page. Leave a field empty and it is not shown. Ask the accountant whether the number series is right before real customers (docs/LEGAL_TODO.md).
invoice.name: Company name
invoice.footer: Footer note (optional, for example: valid without signature)

prices.title: Prices
prices.sub: What the platform charges, in US dollars. Change a price here: no code change and no restart.
prices.note: A change applies to new payments only. A payment already made, and a subscription that already renews, keep the price they have. Every change is written to the audit log.
prices.emptyText: The prices are created when the platform starts.
prices.notSet: Not set: it cannot be charged until you set it
prices.invalid: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 25 or 24.50.

vouchers.ruleLowersText: One payment: a launch package or an Event pass.
vouchers.ruleNeverText: What a square pays when it renews, or the Live period inside a first payment.
vouchers.noPartnersText: A partner brings customers with their own codes, so you can see what each one has brought in.
vouchers.simNote: Uses the setting above, also before it is saved. Dates, packages and use limits are not checked here.
vouchers.stackNote: A customer can type more than one code. Choose what happens then. A code can only be combined when it is marked so in its own form.

stackMode.label: When more than one code is typed

stackHint.best: The code that takes most off is used; the others are ignored. No code needs to be marked.
stackHint.sequential: Each code lowers what is left after the one before (20 % then 10 % is 28 % off). Every code must be marked 'can be combined'.
stackHint.additive: The discounts add up on the same price (20 % and 10 % is 30 % off). Every code must be marked 'can be combined'.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.sub: Codes that lower a launch package or an Event pass once, and the partners who bring customers.
vouchers.note: A code lowers one payment: the price of a launch package or an Event pass. It never changes what a square pays when it renews, and never lowers the Live period inside a first payment. A use is a paid order.
vouchers.emptyText: Make a voucher to give a discount, or a partner to start an affiliate.
vouchers.reportNote: Commission owed is what customers paid with the partner's codes, after refunds, times {percent} %. Pay it by hand; the platform does not pay out.
vouchers.fCodeHint: What the customer types. Letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 40.
vouchers.codeLocked: A code that was used on a payment cannot be renamed. Switch it off and make a new one.
vouchers.fMaxUsesHint: Empty = no limit. Only paid orders count.
vouchers.fStackable: Can be combined with another code
vouchers.fNewOnly: New customers only (an organisation that has not paid yet)
vouchers.fCommissionHint: Used in the report only. 0 to 100.
vouchers.badPercent: A percentage is a whole number from 1 to 100.
vouchers.badAmount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 10 or 7.50.
vouchers.badUses: Total uses is a whole number, or empty.
vouchers.badPartner: Give a name and a commission from 0 to 100.

own.emptyText: Clear the search or choose another status.
own.suspendText: The site goes offline and the committee cannot sign in. Data is kept. You can reactivate it at any time.
own.payFailedText: The next retry is scheduled for {next}. The site stays online until the grace period ends.
own.reqEmptyText: This tenant has not asked for support.
own.notFoundText: This tenant does not exist (demo data).
own.subsSub: Money and plans across all squares, in US dollars.
own.kpiTrialNote: Free days not yet paid for
own.subsEmpty: No squares with a plan yet.
own.errorText: The billing provider did not respond.

overview.title: Overview
overview.weeksNew: {users} new people, {squares} new squares, week of {date}
overview.allClearText: Requests, help asked and failed squares will show up here.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.intro: What waits for a person. An item goes by itself when it is handled. You are also told by e-mail at the staff notice address.
attention.allClearText: A request, a call for help or a failed square will show up here and in the side bar.

kind.google_requested: Google sign-in not switched on yet
kind.mail_domain_requested: Own sending domain requested: set it up or turn it down
kind.site_domain_requested: Own website domain requested: add it on the host and activate it, or turn it down
kind.site_domain_help: Asked for IT help with the own website domain (a one-time support fee)
kind.mail_domain_help: Asked for IT help with the own sending domain (a one-time support fee)
kind.support_granted: The owner gave support access: not opened yet

siteDomain.title: Own website domain
siteDomain.notGrove: This square's package does not include an own website domain (it is a Grove feature).
siteDomain.helpAskedNote: The owner asked for IT help: a small one-time support fee, agree it with the owner and invoice it by hand.
siteDomain.none: The owner has not asked for a domain. A domain is pointed with a CNAME at {target}.
siteDomain.requestedLine: The owner asked for this domain on {when}.
siteDomain.step1: Add {domain} as a custom domain on the square site in Render (the services list, the square site, Settings, Custom Domains). It counts against the included domains.
siteDomain.step2: When Render shows it as verified, press Activate. The square is then served on it and the owner is told by e-mail.

dns.unchecked: The DNS has not been looked at.
dns.pointing: The DNS leads to {target}: the owner has added the record.
dns.not_pointing: The DNS does not lead to {target} yet. The owner may still be adding the record.
dns.unknown: The name does not answer yet.

siteDomain.stepAuto: Press Activate: rootsquares adds the domain on Render and asks Render to check the DNS. The owner is then told by e-mail.

render.off: Render is not connected here (no key): add and remove the domain on Render by hand.
render.not_added: Render does not hold this domain yet.
render.unverified: Added on Render, not verified yet: Render is waiting for the owner's DNS record. Look again in a while.
render.verified: Verified on Render: the domain is served.
render.unknown: Render did not answer. Look again, or look at it in the Render dashboard.

siteDomain.removeAuto: Removing deletes the domain on Render as well (and its www or bare twin). If the owner removed it, delete it on Render by hand.
siteDomain.noteHint: Optional. For example: the domain is not reachable, or it belongs to someone else.
siteDomain.signin: After activating: run flask sync-square-auth {slug} so the square's sign-in trusts the new address, and tell the owner (guide 40).
siteDomain.removeAsk: The square stops being served on this domain. Remove it in Render as well.

mailDomain.title: Own sending domain
mailDomain.notGrove: This square's package does not include an own sending domain (it is a Grove feature).
mailDomain.noKey: RESEND_DOMAINS_API_KEY is not set on this server: nothing can be set up, checked or removed here yet.
mailDomain.helpAskedNote: The owner asked for IT help: a small one-time support fee, agree it with the owner and invoice it by hand.

state.registered: Set up · waiting for DNS records

mailDomain.none: The owner has not asked for an own sending domain.
mailDomain.autoOn: Automatic approval is on (MAIL_DOMAIN_AUTO_APPROVE): an owner's request is set up at once and you are only told. A request waits here only when the server has no domain key or approval is switched off.
mailDomain.requestedLine: The owner asked {when}. Check the domain is theirs and correct it if needed. Setting up registers it at Resend and e-mails the owner the next step.
mailDomain.noteHint: Only needed if you turn it down.
mailDomain.removeAsk: Remove this domain at Resend and from the square? The owner can ask again.
mailDomain.autoCheck: The hourly job (flask mail-domain-run) checks the status and e-mails the owner when it's verified.

square.synced: Sign-in settings sent to the provider.
square.googleOn: Switch Google on at the provider
square.googleOff: Switch Google off at the provider
square.googleNote: Add the callback URL in Google Cloud Console first.
square.refunded: Refunded. The renewal ended and the site goes to sleep.
square.archivedOn: Archived on {date}: its project was deleted
square.refundText: The whole amount goes back to the customer through Stripe, the renewal ends, the paid time ends now and the site goes to sleep. Nothing is deleted. Check first that the customer asked within the refund days and that nothing was published. This cannot be undone.
square.refundTextEvent: The whole payment goes back to the customer through Stripe and the Event pass ends now: its live days stop and the archive starts, so the owner can still sign in to download the reports. Nothing is deleted.
square.refundTextPartial: Only the amount you type goes back to the customer through Stripe. Nothing else changes: the plan, the dates and the site stay as they are.
square.refundedEvent: Refunded. The Event pass ended and its archive started.
square.refundNote: A first payment, a renewal or an Event pass can be refunded for 14 days after it was paid, in full or in part. An upgrade cannot. You decide whether the site was published; the platform never reads a square's content.
square.suspendText: Its public site stops being served. Nothing is deleted.
square.deleteText: Removes its project at the provider and all its data. This cannot be undone.
square.deleteForce: Delete the row even if the provider no longer knows the project

people.title: People
people.noOrgs: Not a member of any organisation.
people.self: This is you; ask another admin to change your access.
people.logoutDone: {n} logins ended. Sign-ins held by Google or an email link are not affected.
people.logoutText: Every login of this person on the platform ends at once.
people.adminText: Platform admins can see every square and organisation in the admin console.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: Who did what on the platform. Only actions and times are kept, never passwords, tokens or connection strings.
audit.noActor: the system, or nobody signed in

events.admin_seed_created: First admin account created at start-up
events.admin_seed_updated: First admin account updated at start-up
events.billing_plan_applied: A plan change was applied to a square
events.square_custom_package: A custom package was agreed with a square
events.custom_guide: The guiding amounts of the custom package were changed
events.invoice_settings: The seller on the invoices was changed
events.opex_actual_recorded: A real monthly cost amount was recorded
events.opex_actual_removed: A real monthly cost amount was removed
events.opex_rate_typed: An exchange rate was typed in
events.billing_plan_downgrade_scheduled: A downgrade was scheduled for the next renewal
events.voucher_settings: The voucher combining rule was changed
events.staff_locked: A staff account was locked after too many wrong passwords
events.staff_login_ended_by_codes: A staff login ended after too many wrong codes
events.staff_logout_all: A staff member signed out everywhere
events.staff_logout_others: A staff member ended their other logins
events.staff_second_step_skipped: A staff member signed in without the authenticator code (development setting)
events.staff_login_failed: A staff sign-in failed (wrong e-mail or password)
events.staff_password_ok: Staff password accepted, second step pending
events.staff_recovery_code_used: A staff recovery code was used
events.staff_second_step_failed: A staff second-step code was wrong
events.staff_seed_created: First staff account created at start-up
events.staff_seed_unchanged: First staff account checked at start-up, nothing changed
events.staff_seed_updated: First staff account updated at start-up
events.auth_refresh_reuse: An old sign-in token was used again, sessions closed
events.billing_asleep_notice: Owner told the square is asleep
events.billing_lapsed: Square put to sleep, nothing was paid
events.square_google_login: Google sign-in set up for the square
events.billing_confirm_on_return: A payment was checked at the provider when the owner came back
events.square_mail_contact: The e-mail contact of the square was changed
events.square_mail_domain_request: An own sending domain was requested
events.square_mail_domain_withdraw: The request for an own sending domain was withdrawn
events.square_mail_domain_approve: An own sending domain was approved
events.square_mail_domain_reject: An own sending domain was turned down
events.square_mail_domain_name: The sender name of the own sending domain was changed
events.square_mail_domain_check: The records of the own sending domain were checked
events.square_mail_domain_instructions: The records of the sending domain were sent to a web person
events.square_mail_domain_help: The owner asked staff for help with the sending domain
events.square_mail_domain_remove: The own sending domain was removed
events.square_site_domain_request: An own website domain was requested
events.square_site_domain_withdraw: The request for an own website domain was withdrawn
events.square_site_domain_activate: An own website domain was activated
events.square_site_domain_reject: An own website domain was turned down
events.square_site_domain_help: The owner asked staff for help with the website domain
events.square_site_domain_remove: The own website domain was removed
events.analytics_switch: Visit counting was switched on or off
events.support_grant: Support access was allowed by the owner
events.support_revoke: Support access was ended by the owner
events.support_request: Support asked an owner for access
events.support_denied: Support tried to open a square without access

audit.viewActor: Their actions in the audit log

health.title: Health and settings
health.sub: What this platform is set up with, and whether each outside service answers right now. Secret values are never shown.

signIn.title: Admin console
signIn.lede: For the people who run rootsquares. This page is not for customers.

second.title: Your code
second.lede: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

enrol.title: Set up your authenticator app
enrol.lede: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (any app that makes 6-digit codes), then type the code it shows. No camera at hand? Type the setup key instead.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
enrol.secretHint: No camera? Type this key into the app (account: your e-mail, time based), or open the link on the phone that has the app.
enrol.recoveryText: Each code works once, when your phone is not at hand. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, then continue.

security.title: Your logins
security.sub: Where your staff account is signed in now. A login ends after 30 minutes without a request, and in any case after 8 hours.
security.everywhereText: Every login of your staff account ends, this one too. You sign in again with your password and a code.

errors.not_asked: No code is asked for now. Sign in again.
errors.not_enrolling: The authenticator app is already set up.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This address may not use the admin API. Check ADMIN_ORIGINS.
